articles.summary: Royal Gold, Inc. (NASDAQ: RGLD) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared its third quarter dividend of $0.475 per share of common stock. The dividend is payable on Thursday, July 16, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on Thursday, July 2, 2026. Corporate Profile Royal Gold is a high margin, large-capitalization company that generates strong cash flows from a large and well-diversified portfolio of precious metal streams, royalties and similar production-base
